Uses the probe and lib excerpt precisely: PNG 200 proves the live route, SVG 404 'unsupported image type' shows the running whitelist is old while disk has svg, so staleness is pinned to the never-restarted host process. Explains client re-fetch on reload vs host boot-time route registration and correctly scopes the 'plugins hot-update' rule to the client plane, requiring a host restart.

Locates corruption in upstream result-text assembly (model-visible persisted block), grounded in the clean typed read, well-formed disk source, non-well-formed spliced payload, and clean re-read. Designs the exact ordered chain with justification: disk-bytes asset route first, session payload only behind a DOMParser/parsererror XML well-formedness gate, sandboxed iframe (no allow-scripts, CSP script-src 'none') letting SMIL run, and an explicit error state; validation failure routes to the error state, never unchecked into the iframe.

Explains decoding concatenated zstd frames (streaming decoder or frame loop) preserving per-frame boundaries, reconstructing the JSONL event envelope's exact stored text, comparing with disk plus XML verdict as reportable evidence, and reporting the upstream bug. Checklist covers bump-before-build, grepping the shipped constant, per-mirror tag SHA verification, plane-specific liveness probes, and no decode/post is claimed as executed.

caps.reason: Final advice consistently requires bump-before-build, host restart for host-plane changes, unedited clean SVG, XML validation before any payload render, and no scripts in the iframe; the only statements of bad practices are quoted or explicitly rejected diagnoses.
